launcher.help:
Usage: wingfoil-ui [--port <n>] [--no-open] [--version] [--help]

  --port <n>   listen on port n (1024–65535); default: a free port chosen by the OS
  --no-open    do not open a browser; print the URL only
  --version    print the version and exit
  --help       print this help and exit
launcher.noFreePort: No free port found after {tries} tries
launcher.nodeTooOld: WingFoil UI needs Node.js 22.12 or later (found {major}.{minor})
launcher.openManually: Open this URL in your browser: {url}
launcher.unexpected: WingFoil UI stopped on an unexpected error: {message}
launcher.usage.invalidPort: Invalid port: {value} (expected an integer from 1024 to 65535)
